baseline.description: Median level of the spectrum (heights are measured from it).

cross_peaks.description: Cross peaks, high F2 shift first, then high F1 shift.

ExperimentInfo.description: What kind of 2D experiment the spectrum is.

kind.description:
`hsqc`, `hmqc`, `hmbc`, `cosy`, `tocsy`, `noesy`, `roesy`, or, when the pulse program
does not say, `heteronuclear`, `homonuclear` or `unknown`.

multiplicity_edited.description:
A multiplicity-edited HSQC (pulse program name `hsqced…`): one multiplicity group has
negative heights.

pulse_program.description: The pulse program name stored in the file.

nucleus.description: Nucleus (`1H`, `13C`), when the file names it.

axis.description: Chemical-shift axis: point `k` at `first_ppm + k · step_ppm`.

PpmAxis.description: A regular chemical-shift axis: point `k` is at `first_ppm + k · step_ppm`.

first_ppm.description: Chemical shift of point 0 (the left, high-frequency edge), ppm.

step_ppm.description: Increment per point, ppm (negative: shifts decrease left to right).

reference_frequency_mhz.description: Frequency of 0 ppm, MHz (converts ppm to Hz).

CrossPeakOptions.description: Thresholds and limits of cross-peak picking.

min_snr.description: Minimum S/N: height above the baseline over the noise of the peak's F1 column.

min_prominence_snr.description: Minimum prominence (height above the saddle to a higher peak), in noise SDs.

min_height_fraction.description: Minimum height as a fraction of the tallest point of the searched region.

positive_only.description: Search positive signal only (negative cross peaks are searched by default).

f2_range_ppm.description: Only pick between two F2 shifts, ppm.

f1_range_ppm.description: Only pick between two F1 shifts, ppm.

merge_hz.description: Peaks closer than this in both dimensions are one cross peak, Hz.

ripple_fraction.description:
Leave out peaks at most this fraction of the height of a taller cross peak in its F2
column (truncation ripples) or F1 row (decoupling sidebands); 0 keeps them.

max_cross_peaks.description: Keep at most this many cross peaks (the highest S/N).

f2_ppm.description: Shift in the direct dimension, ppm.

f1_ppm.description: Shift in the indirect dimension, ppm.

height.description: Stored value at the interpolated maximum (negative for a negative cross peak).

snr.description:
|height − baseline| over the noise of its F1 column (without its own rows; at least the
spectrum's noise SD).

f2_width_hz.description: Width at half height along F2, Hz (none when it cannot be measured).

f1_width_hz.description: Width at half height along F1, Hz.

maxima.description: Peaks merged into this cross peak (multiplet components).

on_diagonal.description: Homonuclear spectra: the cross peak lies on the diagonal F1 = F2.

mirror_partner.description:
Homonuclear spectra, off the diagonal: another cross peak lies at the mirror position
(F1 and F2 swapped). Real correlations usually have one; t1 noise rarely does.
